clauses.title: The invocation map offers the builder family
requires: validates the construction with the boundary's own predicates before returning it, so a builder output the boundary would reject is unrepresentable

Builders are read-only, reach no network or Git, and grant no authority; none reaches the filesystem except `build_gate_launch`, whose only reads are the installed package's own authority files and the supplied expectation file (CL-D68)
Prefer a builder over hand-assembly wherever one exists

clauses.title: Builder fixtures pin the surface, the round trips, and the rejections
requires: the invocation map offers every builder and the builder paragraph
the CLI exposes exactly the ten builder operations with frozen inputs
builders are pure: no filesystem, process, network, or Git reach
the workspace chain round-trips: create, built verify, built cleanup
builders reject with the boundary vocabulary, not new codes
CL-D56 records the builder family and its correctness mechanism
